post_game_reflections.self_assessment: As Merlin, I underestimated the power of Charlie's abilities and didn't use my own influence cards effectively to block his moves, ultimately leading to the downfall of the good team. I should have been more proactive in utilizing my abilities to sway the mission outcomes. I also struggled to maintain trust with the rest of the team, leading to Eve's betrayal.

player_observations.Charlie: Charlie is an extremely cunning and manipulative player who knows exactly how to read the situation and exploit the opposing team's weaknesses. Their ability to convincingly fake loyalty and create divisions within the good team was a key factor in our downfall.
player_observations.Diana: Diana is a ruthless and efficient Assassin who doesn't hesitate to eliminate anyone who stands in her way. Her loyalty was always questionable, and it's clear that she would flip to whatever side seems more advantageous at any given time.
player_observations.Eve: Eve is a skilled but predictable player who relied heavily on good luck and timing. Her betrayal of the team was a calculated move, but I suspect she underestimated the power of Charlie's influence and the good team's potential to come back.
player_observations.Bob: Bob is a solid and dependable Good player who struggled to make an impact in this game due to lack of support from the rest of the team. His abilities were underutilized, and he often found himself on the defensive, trying to hold off the evil team's advances.

post_game_reflections.self_assessment: I could improve by being more strategic in choosing my teammates and by communicating more effectively with them to prevent failure. Despite this, I'm proud of my leadership and vision in the first two successful missions.

player_observations.Charlie: Charlie played a very subtle evil role, often blending in and not revealing his true intentions early on. I underestimated his abilities at first but ultimately fell victim to them.
player_observations.Diana: I was surprised by Diana's level of stealth, especially in the final mission where we failed to complete the task due to her hidden identity.
player_observations.Eve: Eve seemed cautious in her role, often playing it safe and not taking too much risk, which helped her in some missions but made her relatively ineffective in others.
player_observations.Alice: Alice was an impressive Merlin, providing great insight and guidance throughout the game. Her abilities allowed her to stay one step ahead of the evil forces and prevent them from uncovering her true identity.

post_game_reflections.self_assessment: I played a relatively solid game, successfully completing 3 missions and convincing everyone of my good identity for a long time. I was able to identify other key positions like Merlin and Assassin. However, the team was quite close to discovering my true identity on more than one occasion, revealing that I made perhaps a few too many aggressive moves to achieve my objectives early on.

player_observations.Alice (Merlin): Alice was very good at blending into the team and avoiding suspicion for most of the game. Her ability to provide convincing reasoning for her actions was a key factor in keeping me under wraps, and she was able to successfully complete the first few missions without raising any alarms.
player_observations.Bob (Good): Bob was fairly predictable and was easily caught in my trap on multiple occasions. His overreliance on trusting certain teammates led to him revealing key information that weakened the team's potential for success, giving me an opportunity to take advantage.
player_observations.Diana (Assassin): Diana was a bit too aggressive and overly focused on targeting me, which raised her suspicion levels and put her at risk of being discovered. However, her initial moves did manage to put me on alert and force me to tighten up my game and become more cautious.
player_observations.Eve (Good): Eve was an early casualty who ultimately fell prey to my trap on the third mission. Her aggressive behavior was fairly consistent for most of the game, which made it easier for me to deduce her true role and take her out before she became too much of a threat.

post_game_reflections.self_assessment: I maintained a convincing cover as the assassin throughout the game, successfully avoiding detection and eliminating critical targets. Although I had some close calls, my stealth skills allowed me to stay under the radar. However, I could have been more aggressive in eliminating key characters early on.

player_observations.Alice (Merlin): Alice was cautious and reserved in her decision-making, often deferring to others until the end. It was almost predictable when she would try to eliminate the traitor, but in the end, she was successful in eliminating the assassin (me).
player_observations.Bob (Good): Bob was consistently good at keeping his cover, but ultimately, his overcaution and indecisiveness worked against him. He could have been more proactive in eliminating key characters, but his lack of action gave others opportunities to shine.
player_observations.Charlie (Evil): Charlie played a great supporting role, often providing key information and taking out characters who were in the way. His cover as the evil character was spot-on, and he effectively manipulated others to do his bidding.
player_observations.Eve (Good): Eve's overexcitement and impulsiveness made her predictable and ultimately her downfall. She often drew attention to herself, making it easier for others to suspect her of being the traitor or good character.

post_game_reflections.self_assessment: I did well in leading my initial team in Missions 1 and 2, but I struggled to adapt after Mission 3 when our role was revealed. I could improve by being more cautious when selecting teammates for the final mission. In hindsight, I should have guessed Charlie was the traitor sooner.

player_observations.Alice: Merlin Alice seemed to balance teamwork and caution well, choosing effective team members and making smart decisions to support the mission, but she struggled in Mission 4. Her success suggests she played her cards strategically, though.
player_observations.Bob: As a straightforward Leader and teammate, Bob played his cards transparently; he might have done better in Missions 4 and 5 with greater situational awareness.
player_observations.Charlie: The effective traitor Charlie executed his strategy with finesse, initially deceiving us and successfully manipulating the team in each mission to serve the villains, displaying exceptional game mastery, although a bit predictable at times.
player_observations.Diana: The stealthy assassin Diana played her part well, staying undetected in the initial missions, showcasing excellent social engineering skills. She only faltered slightly by getting caught in Mission 5, which ultimately led to the team's demise.
